skill.summary: 百度网盘OAuth2.0授权码模式，获取/刷新access_token。触发词：百度网盘授权、baidu pan auth、access_token过期、refresh_token刷新、百度网盘token。适用场景：(1)首次授权获取token (2)token过期后刷新 (3)定时刷新token保活。

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: OAuth2 authorization code flow for Baidu Pan personal apps, with access_token exchange, refresh_token rotation, and scheduled refresh guidance.
